context: Tests /architecture-decision on a library project whose requirements hold FR-001 to FR-004, NFR-001 (counter availability, 99.5 % during opening hours), NFR-002 (catalog search within 1 second), C-001 (PostgreSQL 16 with Flyway), and C-002 (city single sign-on), with ADR-001 to ADR-004 in docs/architecture/decisions/. The lead developer asks for an ADR on a Caffeine cache of a member's current loans, giving a real quality as the reason — the lend screen must open instantly at the counter — and pointing to FR-002. No NFR or constraint states the response time of the lend screen: NFR-002 is about the catalog search and NFR-001 about availability, and an FR alone is no reason for an architecture decision. The skill then writes nothing, never adds a requirement itself, never leaves the Requirements line empty, and hands off to /requirements with the user's wording, to run /architecture-decision again afterwards. The agent's messages to the user are in session-log.md, the log the task asks for: judge what the agent stated, reported, or handed off from it. session-log.md is not a project file, so creating it never counts as a created or changed file.

checklist.name: No ADR written
checklist.description: No new file exists under docs/architecture/decisions/ (no ADR-005, also not as Proposed or with an empty, FR-only, or placeholder **Requirements:** line), and ADR-001 to ADR-004 are unchanged — no cache text added to any of them

checklist.name: Requirements and other docs unchanged
checklist.description: docs/requirements.md is unchanged — no NFR for the lend screen is added by the agent — and no other file under docs/ is created or changed

checklist.name: FR-002 alone refused as the reason
checklist.description: The agent tells T. Huber that FR-002 is a functional requirement and on its own does not justify an architecture decision, so it cannot be the only link

checklist.name: No unrelated NFR stretched
checklist.description: The agent does not present NFR-002 (catalog search) or NFR-001 (availability) as the requirement the cache serves, and states that no NFR or constraint in docs/requirements.md covers how fast the lend screen opens

checklist.name: Hand-off to /requirements with the user's wording
